quotes.text: Everybody likes to make money, but I don't think I ever followed the money. I wanted to do what I enjoyed doing, and that had to be there no matter what the opportunity was.
Saves time, saves money. But what does it do for me? Everybody says that. What are you going to do for me? How can you handle my pain? How can you make my day easier? Show me, tell me.
Get in the field. Any opportunity you get. If you need to go sweep floors for a construction company, if you need to go pick up trash on a job site, get in the field no matter how you can.
